title: Fractional Clock Divider with Accumulator
text: Clock divider that divides frequency of input signal by fractional number, 2 inputs, 3 outputs; {Enable increased buffer size} and {Buffer size} sets the number of samples of the input buffering available during. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: div-by
ports.summary: Ratio of output to input clock frequency fractional scalar

ports.name: carry
ports.summary: Activates the pulse swallow function when state port overflows 0 (default) | 1

params.name: Enable increased buffer size
params.values: Enable increased buffer size off (default) | on

params.name: Buffer size
params.values: Number of samples of the input buffering available during simulation 1 (default) | positive integer scalar
